comments.body_html: In your code Component.cs file has definition “private static Dictionary<int, PlayerInfo> playerInfoMapping = new Dictionary<int, PlayerInfo>();”. This is not thread safe dictionary but it can be accessed from different threads for simultaneous reading and writing (timer elapsed event thread reads data, for example, while main thread may modify the dictionary). I think either concurrent dictionary should be used or proper locking mechanism should be implemented.

comments.author: wizard83
comments.body_html:
Bots can enter standby mode by default. This was introduced a couple of patches ago. While you’re far away, the bots move to a safe location, take cover, and enter standby mode, waiting for you to approach. At a distance of approximately 250-300 meters, they wake up.

This mod completely disables the bot; it’s invisible and can’t be damaged. The PC doesn’t waste resources on disabled bots, thus increasing the game’s FPS.
